type: Read-only fresh per-file SHA256 and literal-byte archive verification
authority: Parent requested independent current-local archive verification only.
method: Read current full glyph source-map, reference v2 scope-manifest and review, and both cleanup records.
Recompute SHA256 for every current local regular archive file.
Match every source-map/reference-manifest record; verify reference file byte counts.
Independently gzip -t the glyph tar.gz, reference v2 tar.gz, and original archived daily-third.py.gz; each separate command returned actual exit0.

For all82 files extract only their matching tar members without disk writes, compare SHA256 and separately pipe to cmp -s against the current local original with pipefail and failure exit propagation.
Compare all21 retained reference original-local files directly using cmp -s, including current v2 review; all matched.
Run original glyph SHA256SUMS check:58/58 actual exit0; the checksum file itself is included in the82-member roundtrip check.
Decode original-driver/daily-third.py.gz and match a3830c73a5441b72bf1702b3611415f843466f55b56abd2c21554591bde0cc48 expected unadapted source hash.
source_availability_boundary: Glyph55 original remote temporary files were already removed after the preceding verified archive. Their recorded original hashes are preserved in source-map, and all archived bytes still match them; this pass cannot freshly compare removed remote originals. Reference21 local originals remain and were freshly compared. Neither archive hash integrity proves external source truth or that any competitor interaction was performed.
phase_count_note: Reference cleanup-result.json archive_regular_file_count22 describes the pre-cleanup-record archival check; current archive contains23 =21 listed records +scope-manifest +cleanup-result. This is a phase count distinction, not a missing/mismatched file. Glyph59 =56 original payloads +source-map +temporary-cleanup +SHA256SUMS.

glyph_PGHOST_preflight.failure: Self-added Explicit PG environment/PGHOST guard rejected the original libpq local-socket environment before runtime/DB creation.
glyph_PGHOST_preflight.interpretation: Driver preflight failure, not a production login/render failure; logs and first script preserved byte-for-byte.

glyph_historic_missing_glyph_candidate.scope: Five no-input settling frames and normal c/h on one formal TUI
glyph_historic_missing_glyph_candidate.interpretation: Current glyph pixels are normal and five untouched frames identical; this does not eliminate original archived four-client attempt2 initial-B tofu, explain cause, or prove a fix.
glyph_historic_missing_glyph_candidate.font_limit: Default-shell fc-match matches LilyHanSans; private XDG fc-match matches DejaVu Sans. Neither identifies WezTerm actual per-glyph font. No font or product changes.

reference_partial_download.reason: partial timed-out download, never visually reviewed

preserved_failures.reference_fetch_failures: v2 review records web503/auth_not_found plus intermittent curlDNS/transfer timeouts. Only6 explicitly listed raw web responses are preserved; partial Abatable image and unsaved HTML/API are not silently credited as full material.

competitor_and_design_reference_limits.wechat_help_images: Three official Windows4.0+ cropped/marked loading/space/permission help illustrations, not whole live desktop screenshots and not version-pinned to4.1.15.
competitor_and_design_reference_limits.promotional_visuals: QQ official image/video sampled2/7/10s and WeChat illustrative SVG/derivedPNG are decorative/placeholder negatives, not current desktop UI flow captures; QQ video not fully visually reviewed.
competitor_and_design_reference_limits.award_submission_images: twks and FWA Ceramic Beats are static author submissions on official award platforms, not current live keyboard/loading/play/CLEAR/save verification.
competitor_and_design_reference_limits.PDF: Full Mobile Excellence PDF bytes are preserved and reviewed in prior primary reference work. It has no authoring date and legacy mobile-web terminology; not a2026 desktop/TUI scoring standard.
competitor_and_design_reference_limits.layout_limit: No current QQ login-size evidence; compact Chat460x600 cannot be represented as a precisely measured QQ ratio.
competitor_and_design_reference_limits.attribution: These scope limits are checked against the archived v2 review/manifest; this audit adds integrity evidence, not new public-source fetches or new pixel/interaction claims.
